record.bible_text: Why standest<WH05975><WTH8799> thou afar off<WH07350>, O LORD<WH03068>? <FI>why<Fi> hidest<WH05956><WTH8686> thou <FI>thyself<Fi> in times<WH06256> of trouble<WH06869>?

The wicked<WH07563> in <FI>his<Fi> pride<WH01346> doth persecute<WH01814><WTH8799> the poor<WH06041>: let them be taken<WH08610><WTH8735> in the devices<WH04209> that<WH02098> they have imagined<WH02803><WTH8804>. <RF>The wicked...: Heb. In the pride of the wicked he doth persecute<Rf>

For the wicked<WH07563> boasteth<WH01984><WTH8765> of his heart's<WH05315> desire<WH08378>, and blesseth<WH01288><WTH8765> the covetous<WH01214><WTH8802>, <FI>whom<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> abhorreth<WH05006><WTH8765>. <RF>heart's: Heb. soul's<Rf> <RF>blesseth...: or, the covetous blesseth himself, he abhorreth the LORD<Rf>

The wicked<WH07563>, through the pride<WH01363> of his countenance<WH0639>, will not seek<WH01875><WTH8799> <FI>after God<Fi> : God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> not in all his thoughts<WH04209>. <RF>God is...: or, all his thoughts are, There is no God<Rf>

His ways<WH01870> are always<WH06256> grievous<WH02342><WTH8799>; thy judgments<WH04941> <FI>are<Fi> far above<WH04791> out of his sight: <FI>as for<Fi> all his enemies<WH06887><WTH8802>, he puffeth<WH06315><WTH8686> at them.

He hath said<WH0559><WTH8804> in his heart<WH03820>, I shall not be moved<WH04131><WTH8735>: for <FI>I shall<Fi> never<WH01755><WH01755> <FI>be<Fi> in adversity<WH07451>. <RF>never: Heb. unto generation and generation<Rf>

His mouth<WH06310> is full<WH04390><WTH8804> of cursing<WH0423> and deceit<WH04820> and fraud<WH08496>: under his tongue<WH03956> <FI>is<Fi> mischief<WH05999> and vanity<WH0205>. <RF>deceit: Heb. deceits<Rf> <RF>vanity: or, iniquity<Rf>

He sitteth<WH03427><WTH8799> in the lurking places<WH03993> of the villages<WH02691>: in the secret places<WH04565> doth he murder<WH02026><WTH8799> the innocent<WH05355>: his eyes<WH05869> are privily set<WH06845><WTH8799> against the poor<WH02489>. <RF>are...: Heb. hide themselves<Rf>

He lieth in wait<WH0693><WTH8799> secretly<WH04565> as a lion<WH0738> in his den<WH05520>: he lieth in wait<WH0693><WTH8799> to catch<WH02414><WTH8800> the poor<WH06041>: he doth catch<WH02414><WTH8799> the poor<WH06041>, when he draweth<WH04900><WTH8800> him into his net<WH07568>. <RF>secretly: Heb. in the secret places<Rf>

He croucheth<WH01794><WTH8799>, <FI>and<Fi> humbleth<WH07817><WTH8799> himself, that the poor<WH02426><WTH8675><WH02489><WTH8676><WH02489> may fall<WH05307><WTH8804> by his strong ones<WH06099>. <RF>He...: Heb. He breaketh himself<Rf> <RF>by...: or, into his strong parts<Rf>

He hath said<WH0559><WTH8804> in his heart<WH03820>, God<WH0410> hath forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804>: he hideth<WH05641><WTH8689> his face<WH06440>; he will never<WH05331> see<WH07200><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> .<CM>

Arise<WH06965><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>; O God<WH0410>, lift up<WH05375><WTH8798> thine hand<WH03027>: forget<WH07911><WTH8799> not the humble<WH06035><WTH8675><WH06041>. <RF>humble: or, afflicted<Rf>
Wherefore doth the wicked<WH07563> contemn<WH05006><WTH8765> God<WH0430>? he hath said<WH0559><WTH8804> in his heart<WH03820>, Thou wilt not require<WH01875><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> .

Thou hast seen<WH07200><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> ; for thou beholdest<WH05027><WTH8686> mischief<WH05999> and spite<WH03708>, to requite<WH05414><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> with thy hand<WH03027>: the poor<WH02489> committeth<WH05800><WTH8799> himself unto thee; thou art the helper<WH05826><WTH8802> of the fatherless<WH03490>. <RF>committeth: Heb. leaveth<Rf>

Break<WH07665><WTH8798> thou the arm<WH02220> of the wicked<WH07563> and the evil<WH07451> <FI>man<Fi> : seek out<WH01875><WTH8799> his wickedness<WH07562> <FI>till<Fi> thou find<WH04672><WTH8799> none<WH01077>.
The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> King<WH04428> for ever<WH05769> and ever<WH05703>: the heathen<WH01471> are perished<WH06><WTH8804> out of his land<WH0776>.

LORD<WH03068>, thou hast heard<WH08085><WTH8804> the desire<WH08378> of the humble<WH06035>: thou wilt prepare<WH03559><WTH8686> their heart<WH03820>, thou wilt cause thine ear<WH0241> to hear<WH07181><WTH8686>: <RF>prepare: or, establish<Rf>

To judge<WH08199><WTH8800> the fatherless<WH03490> and the oppressed<WH01790>, that the man<WH0582> of the earth<WH0776> may no more<WH03254><WTH8686> oppress<WH06206><WTH8800>. <RF>oppress: or, terrify<Rf><CM>
